name: Ático Curvo - Destudio
summary:
"Ático curvo" offers a 3d recreation of the reform of a house. Through the application you can explore the interior of the houses interacting with its elements. There is also the possibility of using the different tools offered, we highlight the dimensioning of elements, making annotations, saving proposals for materials and colors, or viewing project plans.
